domain.name: Consumer App
domain.description: Everyday utility and productivity software — the agent reads/writes structured personal data and calls a modest set of well-known tools.

governance.name: Quorum / Consensus
governance.description: Multiple parties — agents and/or humans — must agree before an action lands.

latency.name: Real-Time (<100ms)
latency.description: Synchronous interaction loop where the agent must respond within a frame or a breath — games, AR, voice.
examples: AR overlay that tracks head movement

pitch: A consumer app governed by quorum / consensus, operating at real-time (<100ms) latency.
